name: io.github.waiky-github/CrawlEyes
description: Web scraping & search for AI agents: extract, SearXNG/Tavily search, rerank. No API key needed.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base URL of a SearXNG instance (e.g. http://localhost:8080). If unset, falls back to Tavily keyless.
environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Tavily API key for higher-rate search fallback. If unset, uses Tavily keyless (rate-limited).
environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
